note: Bibb County AL parcels are published only through a Flagship GIS (MapGuide) public viewer at bibb.alabamagis.com. The NSGIC portal lists Bibb's parcel access as indirect (viewer only, no API or download URL). The Flagship host exposes a WMS (raster map images only) and a WFS whose capabilities list no parcel feature types. No ArcGIS REST, WFS, OGC API Features, or bulk-download parcel service was found. The PowerSouth Alabama_Parcel_Data service has no Bibb layer (layer 4 is absent). Searches for Bibb County GIS and parcel services turned up no other source.
